technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present potential bounce setup, but lack of moving average support, negative CMF, weak ADX, and bearish stochastic cross create high execution risk with poor confluence.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 20 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed (small purchases offset by larger sale) from junior member with minimal conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (305.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, NFP event imminent, and earnings binary in 20 days—ACN faces compounded macro and event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) in fear-zone market sentiment create contrarian bounce potential near support at 269.30.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 20 days, zero moving average support, negative CMF, weak ADX, and bearish stochastic cross eliminate confluence and create compounded execution risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9, Stoch RSI) present theoretical bounce setup, but severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) and zero moving average confluence eliminate risk/reward validity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 20 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and VIX crisis creates compounded downside risk that oversold bounce cannot offset.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 2 other IT holdings in 16-position portfolio creates sector concentration risk; skip preserves dry powder for higher-conviction setups.
